info.name: CamionManager API
info.description: Complete API collection for CamionManager backend - Truck Management System

item.name: Authentication

request.description: Register a new chauffeur. Account will be pending until admin approves it. Note: role field is removed, registration is only for chauffeurs.
Login as admin user
Login as chauffeur user
Get current user profile (requires authentication)
Refresh access token using refresh token
Logout user and clear refresh token

item.description: Authentication endpoints for user registration, login, logout, and token management

item.name: User Management

request.description: Create a new admin user (Admin only). Only admins can create other admin accounts.
Get all users (Admin only)
Get all chauffeurs with pending approval status (Admin only)
Get user details by ID (Admin only)
Approve a chauffeur account (Admin only)
Reject a chauffeur account (Admin only)
Delete a user by ID (Admin only)

item.description: User management endpoints for admin operations

item.name: Truck Management

request.description: Create a new truck (Admin only)
Get all trucks (All authenticated users)

query.description: Filter by status: Disponible, En Mission, En Maintenance
Filter by fuel type: Diesel, Gasoline, Other

request.description: Get trucks with multiple filters (All authenticated users)
Get only available trucks (status: Disponible)
Get truck statistics aggregated by status and fuel type (Admin only)
Get truck details by ID (All authenticated users)
Update truck details (Admin only)
Update only truck status (Admin only). Options: Disponible, En Mission, En Maintenance
Delete a truck by ID (Admin only)

item.description: Truck management endpoints with full CRUD operations

item.name: Trailer Management

request.description: Create a new trailer (Admin only)
Get all trailers (All authenticated users)

query.description: Filter by status: Disponible, En Mission, En Maintenance
Filter by type: Frigo, Plateau, Fourgon, Citerne, Benne, Porte-conteneur

request.description: Get trailers with multiple filters (All authenticated users)
Get only available trailers (status: Disponible)
Get trailer statistics aggregated by status and type (Admin only)
Get trailer details by ID (All authenticated users)
Update trailer details (Admin only)
Update only trailer status (Admin only). Options: Disponible, En Mission, En Maintenance
Delete a trailer by ID (Admin only)

item.description: Trailer management endpoints with full CRUD operations

item.name: Tires

request.description: Create a new tire (Admin only). Required fields: serialNumber, brand, size, installationDate, vehiclePosition, associatedVehicleType, associatedVehicleId
Get all tires with optional filters: status, brand, vehicleType, vehicleId, position
Get a single tire by ID with populated vehicle information
Get all tires for a specific vehicle (Truck or Trailer)
Get all tires by status. Options: Bon, À remplacer, Usé
Get tire statistics including counts by status, brand, and vehicle type (Admin only)
Update tire information (Admin only). Can update any field except serialNumber
Update only tire status (Admin only). Options: Bon, À remplacer, Usé
Delete a tire by ID (Admin only)

item.description: Tire management endpoints with full CRUD operations and vehicle associations

item.name: Fuels

request.description: Create a new fuel record (Admin only). Total cost is calculated automatically.
Get all fuel records with optional filters: linkedDriver, linkedVehicle, linkedTrip, startDate, endDate, fuelStationLocation, minCost, maxCost
Get a single fuel record by ID with populated driver, vehicle, and trip information
Get all fuel records for a specific driver
Get all fuel records for a specific vehicle
Get all fuel records for a specific trip
Get fuel statistics including total cost, quantity, avg price, and breakdowns by driver, vehicle, and month (Admin only)
Update fuel record information (Admin only). Total cost is recalculated automatically.
Delete a fuel record by ID (Admin only)

item.description: Fuel tracking endpoints with driver, vehicle, and trip associations

item.name: Trips

request.description: Create a new trip (Admin only). Trip number is auto-generated.
Get all trips with optional filters: status, assignedDriver, assignedTruck, assignedTrailer, startDate, endDate, startPoint, destinationPoint
Get a single trip by ID with populated driver, truck, and trailer information
Get all trips for a specific driver
Get all trips for a specific truck
Get all trips by status. Options: À faire, En cours, Terminé
Get trip statistics including counts by status, driver, truck, and total distance (Admin only)
Generate mission order PDF for a specific trip
Update trip information (Admin only)
Update only trip status (Admin only). Options: À faire, En cours, Terminé
Delete a trip by ID (Admin only)

item.description: Trip/Mission management endpoints with auto-generated trip numbers and PDF generation
